facts.fact: The Banque Centrale du Congo says it has granted Wave a licence to operate as an e-money institution in the DRC.

COD.note: The licence date is not given; the notice date is used.
Consumer protection is named only as an aim; no rule or complaints body stated.
Document states nothing on cross-border payments.
Document states nothing on government payments to people.

facts.fact: The Banque Centrale du Congo says it has licensed Wave as an e-money institution, a non-bank payment provider, in the DRC.

COD.note: The rules under which the licence was granted are not named.
No survey share of adults with accounts stated.

facts.fact: The Banque Centrale du Congo says it has licensed Wave as an e-money institution, a new entrant to the DRC market; no Wave service in operation is stated.

COD.note: Document states nothing on tax or fee payment.
